text:
I'm an American living in Mindanao. My heart goes out to the mothers and their families. This should have never happened.!  even myself being an excellent swimmer would not go in waters like that with any kind of ankle weights, not even 5kg.!  They went in the water with 20kg ankle weight..?? What.!!!!!! This is so unbelievable..!!  That was just a drowning waiting to happen, swimming with ankle weights...! When I first heard about the drowning and ankle weights, I was like, were they trying to sink him to the bottom of the ocean.??    This coach is sick in the head..!   The coach should be ousted(fired).. they should block him from leaving the country.  Also criminal charges should be brought against him. He should go to prison for the man-slaughter of two souls..  I don't see where swimming with ankle weights in deep water, has anything to do with basketball... Pro swimmers, or even special forces wouldn't do anything like this. Especially with no life guards, divers, or someone patrolling with a boat. Why ankle weights.?   The Coach and the staff should be making sure nothing happens to these players..!      If I was the family of these young players that drowned.  I would sue the coach and the PBA.  The Coach because it was his fault.  The PBA cuz they knew about the training program, that this coach put on these new players. The PBA did nothing to stop it..
Today I found out that, Rene had bruises on his upper torso. This could mean 4 things, A initiation/hazing took place before the drowning. Two, someone was trying to physically drown him.  Third, the other player that drowned, was the one that tried to rescue him and Rene pulled him under water. And he tried to break free from Rene's grip, hitting him and then drowned himself.  Or his body was under the water for some time, being bashed around by the waves, that could have caused the bruises...??? We'll find out if they do an autopsy, if the bruises were caused before or after his death...    I wish we knew all the details, hopefully soon, other players that were there, will step up and say what happened...  Also If there was foul play, they need to check for defensive wounds and look under his finger nails.    But I just think he went under the water and the other player tried to help and was pulled under by Rene.  Many people that are drowning do this because they are panicking. But this is my speculation.  We'll see when everything comes to light about what happened, unless it's swept under the rug..?   I guess, the young players had to give up their phones, for the whole week, during that training.??  We should call it hell week, cuz with those ankle weights it was hell on those boys..  unbelievable..!!  Again my heart goes out to the parents and their families..😢  I pray that God(Jesus) gives your family's comfort through all of this.  I also pray that the truth comes out..! 🙏🏻 Love and prayers, Ray... ❤️🇺🇲🇵🇭✝️
